newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products-mogas falls, others steady, firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products-mogas falls, others steady, firm.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday. Naphtha ended steady but the swaps backwardation narrowed as ample prompt availability hurt March, and higher crude futures and buying by Far East players helped April swaps
Gasoline barges fell $1 but Eurograde ended back above the $200 level as crude futures rallied nearly 60 cents a barrel.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were firmer, trading as high as $91 fob ARA. High sulphur cargoes were weaker.
Heating oil oil gained $1-2 with futures and broadly steady premium but diesel premiums dipped $2 or so wiping out screen rises. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
